title: 龙国篇 第三十六章 游刃有余龙国篇 第三十五章 在劫难逃
content_zh:
夜如浓墨般沉重，黑袍人的身影在黑暗中若隐若现，步伐沉重而有力，下一刻，如同鬼魅般发起了冲锋，气势来势汹汹。
叶恒站在阵前，他的眼中闪烁着坚定的光芒，仿佛能穿透这黑袍人的全部动作。
他的剑尖犹如冷月凝霜，直指那汹涌而来的黑袍身影，他摆出的战斗姿态充满了蓄势待发的力量，剑身闪烁着凛冽的寒光，与夜空中皎洁的月光交相辉映，仿佛是天边滑落的一道银河。
黑袍人步伐沉重而有力，一步一步逼近，仿佛每一步都踏在人的心弦上。他的斗篷在风中猎猎作响，与空气的摩擦声在寂静的夜空中回荡，犹如战鼓的擂动，令人心潮澎湃，血脉贲张。
然而，叶恒却如磐石般岿然不动，他的目光犹如深渊般深邃，凝视着黑袍人的每一个细微动作。他仿佛已经洞察了黑袍人的破绽，那种坚定与自信，直接穿透黑夜的迷雾，直抵人心。
叶恒深吸一口气，整个身体仿佛紧绷的弓弦，随时准备射出致命的箭矢。他犹如一只猎豹，在暗夜中蛰伏，等待着最佳的猎食时机。
“就是现在”
转眼间，叶恒凶猛地向前冲去，两人的身影在月光下交错，剑光与寒光交织成一幅惊心动魄的画面。
黑袍人的身影紧随其后，他的剑法凌厉无比，每一次挥剑都伴随着破空的呼啸声，仿佛有雷霆万钧之势。剑光在月光下闪烁，寒光逼人，将周围的空气都切割得支离破碎。
而叶恒则凭借着惊人的速度和力量，在黑袍人凌厉的攻击中穿梭自如，汗水在月光下闪烁着晶莹的光芒，那是他全力以赴的象征，也是他坚韧不拔的证明。他的身形灵活如猿猴，时而跃起，时而翻滚，每一次都巧妙地避开了黑袍人的致命一击，同时寻找着反击的机会。
两人的战斗越来越激烈，每一次的交错都势均力敌，每一次的碰撞都伴随着金属交击的清脆响声，周围的空气都被他们的剑气所撕裂。
就在瞬息万变之时，叶恒的双眸骤然亮起璀璨的金光，凝聚全身的力量，随后，他猛地挥动手中的烈阳，剑尖所指，星辰之力汇聚，化作一道璀璨无匹的剑气。
这一剑，如同破晓的曙光，瞬间撕裂深沉的夜空，剑气所过之处，留下了一道道耀眼的金光轨迹。黑袍人虽然反应神速，但在这雷霆万钧的一击之下，已是避无可避。他只能眼睁睁地看着那道剑气疾驰而来，犹如死神的镰刀，无情地将自己斩为两半。
然而，事实真的如此？
看似被剑气斩成两半的黑袍人，竟然在剑气掠过的瞬间，化作了一片片飘落的枫叶。那些枫叶在夜空中轻轻摇曳，宛如一首无声的挽歌。而黑袍人，则在这枫叶飘零之际，从另一个位置中悄然现身，仿佛从未受到过任何伤害。
这一突如其来的转变，无疑在叶恒的心中坚定了他的猜测——那黑袍人所施展的，正是命器技中神秘莫测的分身之术。分身之术虽强，但万变不离其宗，其核心终究在于本体。只要找到了本体的位置，那么这分身的存在便如同无根之木，自然难以长久。
叶恒深吸一口气，眼中闪烁着坚定的光芒，他再次发动了凌厉的攻击。然而，这次的黑袍人分身似乎比先前要逊色几分，面对叶恒的猛烈攻势，分身显得有些力不从心，最终在叶恒一连串的斩击下，颓然倒地。
分身破碎的瞬间，叶恒的心中涌起一股强烈的预感，他并非仅仅是在预判下一个分身可能出现的位置，而是直接捕捉到了那黑袍人本体的踪迹。这一发现，让他更加确信了自己的判断。
黑袍人心中涌起一股难以名状的震惊，他向来以隐匿身形、行事神秘而著称，然而此刻，他的秘密竟在这不经意间被眼前之人洞悉。这份突如其来的暴露，让他对这位对手产生了由衷的钦佩。
那招“百枫叶舞”，是他的骄傲，更是他行走江湖的利器。这招独步天下的命技，乃是他多年修炼所得，能够将自身之力融入自然之中，化身为无数飘舞的枫叶，随风而动，感受风的呼吸。在这无垠的枫叶海洋中，他能够随心所欲地选择位置，进行瞬移般的传送，使得对手难以捉摸其行踪。

然而，这“百枫叶舞”虽强，却也有其致命的弱点——那便是施法时间过于漫长。在这漫长的施法过程中，他不得不暴露自己的位置，给对手留下可乘之机。为了弥补这一缺陷，黑袍人不断研究、改进，终于找到了一个巧妙的办法——将分身之术融入其中。
传送的同时，将分身引出去，让敌人与栩栩如生的分身进行战斗，而自己，则利用这难得的间隙，迅速启动传送到别处，同时还在暗处，静静藏匿暗藏观察，等时机成熟给敌人致命一击。
黑袍人眼见叶恒如同利剑般直刺本体，他并未多言，只从漫天飞舞的枫叶中陡然显现，以肉身直面叶恒那势如破竹的一剑。
空气中响起一声震耳欲聋的爆炸，尘埃飞扬，仿佛连时间都在这刻凝固。然而，当尘埃逐渐散去，露出黑袍人的身影时，叶恒的眼神中满是惊愕。
叶恒：“这......这怎么可能？”
他凝望着黑袍人，只见那把名为“烈阳”的宝剑，在黑袍人的肩头仅仅划破了薄薄的一层衣角，连肌肤都未曾触及。
黑袍人微微颔首，脸上带着一丝戏谑的笑容：“你确实聪慧，能如此轻易地破解我的‘百枫叶舞’。”
话音未落，黑袍人已是抬手如电，五指如钩，准备直取叶恒的咽喉。
叶恒顿觉一股难以抗拒的力量束缚住了自己，四肢仿佛被无形的枷锁牢牢锁住，动弹不得。
“这......”叶恒心中惊恐万分，他从未想过自己竟会在这黑袍人面前如此无力。
就在此刻，沉寂的战场被一道身影突然打破，艾希如破晓之光，强势降临。
“红雷月斩——第一重！”艾希的声音清脆而坚定，伴随着她的喝声，一道道炽热的红色雷电如巨龙般腾空而起，带着毁灭的力量，直逼那黑袍人而去。黑袍人原本冷漠的眼神中闪过一丝惊异，他不得不放下手中正在施法的叶恒，身形急速闪动，躲避着这突如其来的雷霆攻击。
“你的对手，现在是我。”艾希的声音在雷霆的轰鸣中显得格外清晰，她身姿挺拔，眼眸中闪烁着坚定的光芒，仿佛已经做好了与黑袍人决一死战的准备。
黑袍人嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，声音中透着一丝不屑：“雷霆秘法？倒是有些门道。自从龙国覆灭后，修炼雷法之人便如凤毛麟角，难觅其踪。不过，你可知，真正的雷法，并非如此浅薄。你所说的那位借鉴上古雷法之人，虽有其形，却无其神。他的雷法，终究只是皮毛。”
艾希不为所动，她紧握着手中的武器，眼中闪烁着坚定的光芒：“即便只是皮毛，也足以让你感到棘手。今日，我便让你见识一下，何为真正的雷霆之力！”
随着她的喝声落下，天空中的红色雷电愈发狂暴，仿佛要将整个天空都撕裂开来，黑袍人的身影在雷电中不断穿梭，寻找机会一击制敌。
艾希：“没错，我是修炼了万翼雷御，但你凭什么就说二代目的雷法是残次品”
黑袍人：“我所言即真理，任何能反噬其主的功法，皆是旁门左道，毫无价值。你若以为雷法便是你所知的那般，那真是大错特错。雷法，乃万法之尊，是至高无上的功法之巅。遥想当年，雷帝便是凭借雷帝秘法，击败了无数上古的强者，包括那些威震寰宇的大能真仙，甚至是神魔与大帝，都未能从他手中讨得半点便宜。”
他顿了一顿，深吸一口长气，仿佛要将整个宇宙都吸入肺腑之中，又继续道：“我为何说你的雷法不过尔尔？因为真正的雷法，蕴含天地之威，拥有毁天灭地的力量。而龙帝，那位上古大帝，也是雷帝唯一爱人，他一人至尊，万法归一，是众神之帝，甚至是元始大帝的佼佼者，他仅凭一个秩序法则，便可令星系崩溃，宇宙颤抖。”
黑袍人的嘴角勾起一抹嘲讽的弧度，目光如刀般锐利：“所以，我为什么说你的雷法就是个垃圾了吧？”
content_en:
The night was as heavy as thick ink, and the figure of the man in black robes loomed in the darkness. His steps were heavy and powerful. The next moment, he charged like a ghost with a fierce momentum.
Ye Heng stood in front of the formation, his eyes flashing with determination, as if it could penetrate all the movements of the man in black robes.
The tip of his sword was like frost on the cold moon, pointing directly at the surging black-robed figure. His fighting posture was full of ready power. The blade of the sword flashed with a cold light, which complemented the bright moonlight in the night sky, and seemed like a Milky Way sliding down the horizon.
The man in black robe's steps were heavy and powerful, approaching step by step, as if every step was stepping on people's heartstrings. His cloak rustled in the wind, and the sound of friction with the air echoed in the silent night sky, like the beating of a war drum, making people's hearts surging and their blood pumping.
However, Ye Heng remained as still as a rock. His eyes were as deep as an abyss, staring at every tiny movement of the man in black robe. He seemed to have seen through the flaw of the man in black robe. That kind of determination and confidence penetrated directly through the fog of the night and reached people's hearts.
Ye Heng took a deep breath, his whole body felt like a tight bowstring, ready to shoot deadly arrows at any time. He is like a cheetah, dormant in the dark night, waiting for the best opportunity to hunt.
"It's now"
In the blink of an eye, Ye Heng rushed forward fiercely. The two figures intertwined under the moonlight, and the sword light and cold light intertwined to form a thrilling picture.
The figure of the man in black robe followed closely behind. His swordsmanship was extremely fierce. Every time he swung his sword, it was accompanied by a whistling sound that broke through the air, as if it had the power of thunder. The sword light flickered in the moonlight, the cold light was so threatening that it cut the surrounding air into pieces.
Ye Heng, on the other hand, relied on his astonishing speed and strength to move freely through the fierce attacks of the men in black robes. His sweat glistened under the moonlight, which was a symbol of his all-out effort and proof of his perseverance. His body was as flexible as an ape, sometimes leaping and sometimes rolling. Each time, he cleverly avoided the fatal blow of the man in black robe, while looking for opportunities to counterattack.
The battle between the two became more and more intense, and each collision was evenly matched. Each collision was accompanied by the crisp sound of metal clashing, and the surrounding air was torn apart by their sword energy.
Just when things were changing rapidly, Ye Heng's eyes suddenly lit up with bright golden light, condensing all the strength in his body. Then, he violently waved the blazing sun in his hand. At the tip of the sword, the power of the stars gathered together and turned into a brilliant and unparalleled sword energy.
This sword, like the dawn of dawn, instantly tore through the deep night sky, leaving behind a trail of dazzling golden light wherever the sword energy passed. Although the man in black robe reacted quickly, he was unable to avoid this thunderous blow. He could only watch helplessly as the sword energy rushed towards him, like the scythe of death, mercilessly cutting him in half.
However, is this really the case?
The man in black robe, who seemed to be cut in half by the sword energy, turned into pieces of falling maple leaves at the moment when the sword energy passed by. Those maple leaves swayed gently in the night sky, like a silent elegy. The man in black robe quietly appeared from another position as the maple leaves were falling, as if he had never been harmed.
This sudden change undoubtedly strengthened Ye Heng's guess in his mind - what the man in black robe performed was the mysterious clone technique in the life weapon technique. Although the technique of clone is powerful, it cannot be separated from its origin, and its core lies in the original body after all. As long as the location of the main body is found, the existence of this clone will be like a tree without roots, and naturally it will not last long.
Ye Heng took a deep breath, his eyes flashing with determination, and he launched another fierce attack. However, this time the black-robed man's clone seemed to be a bit inferior to the previous one. Facing Ye Heng's fierce offensive, the clone seemed a little powerless, and finally fell to the ground under Ye Heng's series of slashes.
pointThe moment his body was shattered, Ye Heng had a strong premonition in his heart. He was not just predicting the possible location of the next clone, but directly captured the traces of the black-robed man's body. This discovery made him more confident in his judgment.
An indescribable shock surged through the heart of the man in black robes. He had always been known for hiding his figure and acting mysteriously. However, at this moment, his secret was inadvertently revealed to the person in front of him. This sudden exposure made him sincerely admire his opponent.
That move "Hundred Maple Leaf Dance" is his pride, and it is also a weapon for him to travel in the world. This unparalleled destiny skill is the result of many years of practice. He can integrate his own power into nature and transform into countless fluttering maple leaves, moving with the wind and feeling the breath of the wind. In this boundless ocean of maple leaves, he can choose his location at will and teleport, making it difficult for his opponents to track his whereabouts.
However, although this "Hundred Maple Leaf Dance" is powerful, it also has its fatal weakness - that is, the casting time is too long. During this long process of casting spells, he had to expose his position, leaving opportunities for his opponents to take advantage of. In order to make up for this shortcoming, the man in black robe continued to research and improve, and finally found an ingenious way - integrating the art of clone into it.
While teleporting, he would lead the clone out, allowing the enemy to fight the lifelike clone, while he would use this rare gap to quickly initiate teleportation to other places, while still hiding quietly in the dark, observing, and waiting for the right time to deliver a fatal blow to the enemy.
The man in black robe saw Ye Heng piercing his body like a sharp sword. He didn't say anything. He suddenly appeared from the maple leaves flying in the sky and faced Ye Heng's powerful sword with his physical body.
There was a deafening explosion in the air, and dust was flying, as if even time had frozen at this moment. However, when the dust gradually dispersed and the figure of the man in black robe was revealed, Ye Heng's eyes were filled with astonishment.
Ye Heng: "This...how is this possible?"
He stared at the man in black robe and saw that the sword named "Fierce Sun" only scratched a thin layer of clothing on the shoulder of the man in black robe, not even touching the skin.
The man in black robe nodded slightly, with a teasing smile on his face: "You are indeed smart, you can crack my 'Hundred Maple Leaf Dance' so easily."
Before he finished speaking, the man in black robe had already raised his hand like lightning, his fingers like hooks, ready to take Ye Heng's throat.
Ye Heng suddenly felt an irresistible force restraining himself, and his limbs seemed to be tightly locked by invisible shackles, unable to move.
"This..." Ye Heng was horrified. He never thought that he would be so powerless in front of this black-robed man.
At this moment, the silent battlefield was suddenly broken by a figure. Like the light of dawn, Ai Xi came powerfully.
"Red Thunder Moon Slash - the first level!" Ai Xi's voice was clear and firm. Along with her shout, blazing red thunder and lightning rose into the sky like a giant dragon, carrying the power of destruction, heading towards the man in black robe. A trace of surprise flashed across the originally indifferent eyes of the man in black robe. He had to put down Ye Heng, who was casting a spell in his hand, and flashed quickly to avoid the sudden thunder attack.
"Your opponent is me now." Ai Xi's voice was particularly clear in the roar of thunder. She stood tall and straight, with a firm light shining in her eyes, as if she was ready for a decisive battle with the man in black robe.
A sneer appeared on the lips of the black-robed man, with a trace of disdain in his voice: "Thunder Secret Technique? There are some skills. Since the fall of the Dragon Kingdom, people who practice Thunder Technique are as rare as a phoenix, and it is hard to find them. However, you know that the real Thunder Technique is not so shallow. The person you mentioned who borrowed the ancient Thunder Technique has its form, but no spirit. His Thunder Technique is only superficial after all."
Ai Xi was unmoved, she held her hand tightlyweapon, with a firm light shining in his eyes: "Even if it is only superficial, it is enough to make you feel troublesome. Today, I will let you see what the real power of thunder is!"
As her shout fell, the red thunder and lightning in the sky became more and more violent, as if it was about to tear the entire sky apart. The figure of the man in black robe kept shuttling through the thunder and lightning, looking for opportunities to defeat the enemy with one strike.
Ai Xi: "Yes, I have practiced Ten Thousand Wings Thunder Technique, but why do you say that the second-generation lightning technique is defective?"
Black-robed man: "What I say is the truth. Any technique that can backfire on its master is a heresy and worthless. If you think that Lei Fa is what you know, you are really wrong. Lei Fa is the lord of all laws and is the supreme being. The pinnacle of martial arts in the world. Back then, the Thunder Emperor relied on the Thunder Emperor's secret method to defeat countless powerful people in ancient times, including those powerful immortals who were powerful in the world, and even gods, demons and emperors, but they could not get any advantage from him. "
He paused, took a long and deep breath, as if he wanted to suck the entire universe into his lungs, and continued: "Why do I say that your thunder method is mediocre? Because the real thunder method contains the power of heaven and earth, and has the power to destroy heaven and earth. And the Dragon Emperor, the ancient great emperor, is also the only lover of the Thunder Emperor. He is the supreme one and unites all laws. He is the emperor of the gods and even the leader of the Yuanshi Emperor. He can make the galaxy collapse and the universe tremble with just one law of order."
The corners of the black-robed man's mouth curved into a mocking arc, and his eyes were as sharp as knives: "So, why do I say that your thunder method is rubbish?"
